title: Woman Taking Selfie in Gym
description: A woman with long white hair stands in a stylized gym, holding a selfie stick with a smartphone. She wears a pink sports bra, peach leggings, pink headphones, and pink sneakers while posing with one hand on her hip.
prompt: A confident plus-size woman with long straight white hair and pink headphones stands in a surreal fitness studio with purple walls and pink floor.
